viralRf.title: GHz Viral-Vector Safety (Preview)
viralRf.subtitleOff: Disabled — applies only when target is a virus preset
viralRf.caveatLead: PREVIEW and UNVALIDATED AT THIS REGIME: do not use to certify a viral-vector workflow.
viralRf.caveatBody: Estimates whether a chosen GHz RF dose would inactivate a viral vector in dish, using the same single-mode Lorentzian capsid model as the resonance chart and an aqueous Debye fit for medium SAR. SAR limits are quoted from IEEE C95.1-2019 (1.6 W/kg public, 8.0 W/kg occupational) as bench reference benchmarks ONLY (EM-exposure regulations for human bodies in air, not in-vitro safety thresholds). Use to compare RF-handling protocols on the bench.
viralRf.presetWarning: Target cell is not a virus preset (no resonant_freq_GHz, capsid_Q, or resonant_threshold_V/cm). Predicted DR is undefined — switch the target to a virus preset to enable.
viralRf.drTip: Predicted resonant disruption ratio Lorentzian capsid response at the chosen GHz field, using the same model as the resonance chart. DR ≥ 1.0 means the field equals the capsid disruption threshold at f_res; for vector preservation aim for DR ≪ 0.1.
viralRf.sarTip: Bulk-medium SAR σ_eff·E²/ρ with σ_eff(ω) = σ_e + ω·ε₀·ε″ from the aqueous Debye fit. Compared against the IEEE C95.1-2019 public-exposure SAR limit (1.6 W/kg) as a bench reference benchmark, NOT a regulatory pass/fail.
viralRf.sarMarginTip: Margin below the public IEEE C95.1 SAR benchmark Positive = SAR under the 1.6 W/kg reference; negative = SAR over. Reference benchmark only — not a regulatory pass/fail.
viralRf.verdictSafe: Verdict: protocol stays under the public SAR benchmark and predicts < 10% vector disruption.
viralRf.verdictBorderline: Verdict: passes the public SAR benchmark but predicted vector DR is in the 0.10–0.50 partial-inactivation band.
viralRf.verdictUnsafe: Verdict: protocol exceeds at least one bench benchmark (SAR over 1.6 W/kg or vector DR ≥ 0.50). Lower the field or move off-resonance to preserve the vector.
viralRf.hint: Lower the RF field amplitude or detune the frequency away from the capsid resonance to drop predicted DR. SAR scales with E²; halving the field drops SAR fourfold.
